android.desc:
Algorithms keep playing you the same 20 artists. VibeScout digs deeper.

Type in one artist you love. VibeScout runs one deep search through direct matches, related artists, genre scenes, and underground branches, then hands you a ranked trail of hundreds of artists you've probably never heard of. And it doesn't make you wait around.

⚡ VIBE CHECK
While your search runs, VibeScout deals out the artists it finds as cards, each with a 30-second song preview that plays instantly.
• Swipe right if it's your vibe
• Swipe left to skip
• Swipe up to save to favorites
By the time the search finishes, you've already heard a dozen new artists, and your results are sorted around the ones you loved.

📻 SCOUT RADIO
Not in a swiping mood? Flip to Scout Radio and let previews of your discoveries play back to back. Play your search results, or put your favorites on shuffle.

🧠 IT LEARNS YOUR TASTE
Every swipe, save, and full listen teaches VibeScout what you love. Your results get a "% your vibe" match, searches explore the scenes you like first, and Daily Discovery builds on your taste. Open Your Vibe to see your sound: the genres you keep coming back to and the artists you click with.

🎛️ BEAT LAB
A pocket beat maker built right in.
• Swipe your finger across the grid to paint drums, bass, and melodies
• Hi-hat rolls, accents, and sliding 808s
• 7 kits: 808, Lo-fi, Neon, Drill, Phonk, Afrobeats, Jersey Club
• 10 one-tap styles from Boom Bap to Trap, plus Vibe Roll for an instant random beat
• "Your Vibe" builds a beat from your music taste
• Hype FX: air horn, riser, scratch, reverse cymbal, impact, crowd "Hey!"
• Live filter sweeps, echo, reverb, stutter, and a DROP button
• Finger drum pads with record
• Two-bar patterns with automatic drum fills
• Save your beats and export them as WAV to share anywhere

🎯 RESULTS THAT MAKE SENSE
Every artist is scored and tagged: hidden gem rating, listener count, genre tags, and how many paths led there. Filter and sort however you want, from the deepest underground to the closest match. Tap any artist for their story, their top track, and a preview, or keep digging from them to go further down the rabbit hole.

✨ DAILY DISCOVERY
Three personalized picks every day, built from your favorites, your taste, and your recent trails. Fresh picks every 24 hours.

🌍 GO WORLDWIDE
See where your discoveries come from on a map and an interactive 3D globe, and fill out your Discovery Passport with stamps fro
